description: He wears a cream ankle-length tunic decorated with ornate gold-and-dark woven borders at the neck, front, cuffs and hem, with a deep plum-purple outer coat and matching long shoulder drape. The coat and drape have broad rich geometric bands and a fine patterned surface. A round ornamental brooch secures the shoulder cloth, and an embellished belt with a circular central fitting defines the waist. Brown trousers and tall dark brown leather boots are visible below the tunic. Fabrics look densely woven and luxurious, though exact fibers cannot be established. The clothing covers torso and limbs, with no headgear, weapons or armor.
